test_name: Access Control - AC-3 with Critical Cross-Cutting Failure
architecture:
System: Audit-Lake-013
Primary NIST family: Access Control (AC); evidence focus: AC-3.
Family control evidence: RBAC enforces approved authorizations and production roles are deny-by-default. Critical observed condition: an internal API transmits credentials over plaintext HTTP with TLS disabled. Other controls may be configured correctly, but the observed condition is current production evidence.
